definitions.explanation: Modifies verbs of refusing, denying, or maintaining a position to express that someone will not budge or compromise. Carries a sense of inflexibility — sometimes admiring, often critical.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頑|がん}として⟦{認|みと}めなかった→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: He stubbornly refused to admit it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頑|がん}として⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}おう→使う：00473_tsukau⟧としない。
examples.english: My grandfather stubbornly refuses to use a smartphone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対意見|はんたいいけん}→反対意見：24246_hantaiiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{頑|がん}として⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げなかった→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧。
examples.english: Even with many objections, the president stubbornly refused to bend on his policy.

notes:
Formed from {頑|がん} (stubborn) + ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (acting as). Almost always pairs with negative verbs of refusing, denying, or rejecting — describing the firmness of someone's resistance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頑|がん}として⟦{認|みと}めない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to stubbornly refuse to admit
- {頑|がん}として⟦{聞|き}かない→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to stubbornly refuse to listen
- {頑|がん}として⟦{譲|ゆず}らない→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧: to stubbornly refuse to yield
- {頑|がん}として⟦{曲|ま}げない→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧: to stubbornly refuse to bend (one's view)
- {頑|がん}として⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧: to stubbornly oppose

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{断固|だんこ}→断固：12714_danko⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: firmly, resolutely — more positive tone; conveys determined principle, not stubbornness
- ⟦{意地|いじ}→意地：01786_iji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: out of sheer stubbornness — informal, suggests pride/spite
- ⟦{決|けっ}して→決して：01254_kesshite⟧: never, by no means — emphasizes the absoluteness of refusal but lacks the stubbornness nuance
